narrative: The new leaf, the ink still wet at the foot. Daylight on the desk now, the candle burned down to a stump. The two lines stand. Nothing is struck through. The lower half of the leaf. The question is the last written line but one. Under the last sentence the leaf is blank. The pen is in the rest.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Visible/present in Read the finished leaf down to the blank
